attributes.name: copy truncation treatment
attributes.definition: How text content is shortened or cut off on the page relative to its full source.

values.definition: Teaser or body copy is cut short with a trailing ellipsis, typically followed by a link or button.
A brand or title label is shortened or misspelled compared with the canonical name (e.g. the document title).
Copy is shown in full without truncation or discrepancy.

attributes.name: markup authoring style
attributes.definition: How the HTML is authored in terms of class naming and line-break handling.

values.value: sparse classes with manual br breaks
values.definition: Few, non-utility class names and hard-coded br tags to break copy lines.
Utility-style class names and line wrapping handled by CSS rather than br tags.

codes.value: sparse classes with manual br breaks
